sentences.text:
Code vs In Re : Ruma Goldar @ Rupa Goldar & Ors on 13
February, 2024

Author: Debangsu Basak
Bench: Debangsu Basak

13.02.2024 S.D. REJECTED C.R.M.(A) 469 of 2024 In Re:- In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Chakdaha Police Station Case No. 61 of 2024 dated 18.01.2024 under Section 498A/304B/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
And In Re : Ruma Goldar @ Rupa Goldar & Ors.
...... petitioners Ms. Minoti Gomes Ms. Dona Sanyal ...for the petitioners Mr. Bitasak Banerjee ...for the State Wife expired.
Post Mortem report apparently suggests that the death was due to hanging.
Petitioners before us are in-laws of such victim.
Materials in the case diary do not rule out to the requirement of interrogation of the petitioners.
In such circumstances, we are unable to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners and the prayer for anticipatory bail is rejected.
The application being CRM (A) 469 of 2024 is dismissed.

(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
